sn4.18:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Magadhesu viharati Pañcasālāyam brāhmaṇagāme || || 2.
sn4.18:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Pañcasālāyaṃ brāhmaṇagāme kumārakānaṃ pāhunakāni bhavanti || || 3.
sn4.18:1.3: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā patta-cīvaraṃ ādāya Pañcasālam brāhmaṇa-gāmaṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi || || 4.
sn4.18:1.4: Tena kho pana samayena Pañcasāleyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā Mārena pāpimatā anvāviṭṭhā bhavanti || ||
sn4.18:1.5: Mā samaṇo Gotamo piṇḍam alatthā ti || || 5.
sn4.18:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā yathā dhotena pattena Pañcasālaṃ brāhmaṇagāmam piṇḍāya pāvisi || tathā dhotena pattena paṭikkami || || 6.
sn4.18:2.2: Atha kho Māro pāpimā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn4.18:2.4: Tathā nu tvaṃ pāpima akāsi yathāhaṃ piṇḍaṃ na labheyyan ti || 8.
sn4.18:2.5: Tena hi bhante Bhagavā dutiyam pi Pañcasālaṃ brāhmaṇagāmam pavisatu ||
sn4.18:2.6: tathāhaṃ karissāmi yathā Bhagavā piṇḍam lacchatī ti || ||
sn4.18:5.1: Atha kho Māro pāpimā || pe || tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || || 1. Sāvatthi nidānam || ||
